# Copilot Instructions for SoftOne App

## Project Overview
- Angular 19 web application with standalone components
- TypeScript
- Routing configured
- Located at e:\SoftOne

## Key Commands
- `npm start` - Start development server (http://localhost:4200)
- `npm run build` - Build for production
- `npm run watch` - Build in watch mode

## Project Structure
- `src/app/` - Main application code
- `src/app/pages/home/` - Home page component
- `src/app/app.routes.ts` - Application routes
- `src/app/app.config.ts` - Application configuration
- `src/app/app.component.ts` - Root component

## Development Notes
- Use standalone components (no NgModules)
- Components are in `src/app/pages/` directory
- Services can be added to `src/app/services/` directory
- Models can be added to `src/app/models/` directory
